items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was with you, now, in the '50s when you had your own label you were trying to, Mars.

ctx.x: Absolutely, most appropriate. And I think that that was some of the best music that those guys could play at the time. That's why it's a high point. I think there's a high point in each period, if you happen to be lucky enough to be in on it, kiss it and say goodbye.
He was with you, now, in the '50s when you had your own label you were trying to, Mars.
Well, I'd say it was Howie Richmond's label, but I was involved.
